title: Fused Hyperoperation Algebra
description: One geometric picture behind the composition law a + b + k·ab (mult-add): stretch a unit box by a one way and b the other, and the extra area is the product term. The repository gathers proofs, numerical checks, figures and write-ups across counting, primes, probability, relativity, gravity, electromagnetism and topology, with a shared machine-checked library of over 3,000 theorems in core Lean 4.
